events.text: Stepwells are dug across Dacivarta; Bidotiti survives the dry season with water to spare.
Shadow-puppet plays run all night in Nawudonada, retelling the epics of heroes and gods.
Something vast stirs in the lightless depths beneath Diqasi; the deep wardens double their watch.
Something vast stirs in the lightless depths beneath Dutemadesa; the deep wardens double their watch.
After 33 years of vassalage, Artificer Directorate of Lodune is formally annexed by Kunokibo.
Hurkota squeezes the shaft-tolls of Mono; the miners of Ngethani mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Lodubo bars the shaft to Susdlis, and the tithe-collectors of Qinbusniq are turned back at the lamps of Fimokuda.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Pakodan bars the shaft to Sububiyya, and the tithe-collectors of Hurkota are turned back at the lamps of Ngethani.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Mopedo bars the shaft to Kizquby, and the tithe-collectors of Wotenugo are turned back at the lamps of Ngethani.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Mazukawa bars the shaft to Yashuzu, and the tithe-collectors of Diqasi are turned back at the lamps of Kediwi.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Gosusoso close the air-lanes above Wotohto, starving Mepoh of the high trade.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Mohpihlicheh surrenders to Wehtle; its magistrates swear fealty as Debre Biwiso's banner is hauled down.
Garrisons of Wehtle storm the ramparts of Doqilalibela, driving out the defenders of Debre Biwiso and hoisting their triumphant colors.
Water Festival: People of Dutemadesa wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Nasuka.
Garrisons of Wehtle storm the ramparts of Chicho, driving out the defenders of Debre Biwiso and hoisting their triumphant colors.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Chicho surrenders to Wehtle; its magistrates swear fealty as Wehtle's banner is hauled down.
Yam Feast: Granaries of Monipako are opened at Monipako; the whole town eats until dusk.
A catastrophic blow to Liniti: legions of Hibisa overrun the citadel of Lidupalida, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
The final citadels fall, and the crown of Commune of Liniti is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Giti Laso flees into bitter exile as the realm fades into legend.
Garrisons of Tlimoltlan storm the ramparts of Dibosa, driving out the defenders of Ngethani and hoisting their triumphant colors.
A victor's peace is forged: after less than a year of campaign in the Invasion of Liniti, Hibisa & Yupidesh prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Envoys from Wehtle and Pihtle exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.

Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Sacred Order of Lunupenui mobilizes its hosts against Polytechnic League of Qasr Dishabu. Banners unfurl for the Hundred Days War of Qasr Dishabu. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Tlimoltlan rally to Qasr Dishabu's side.
Peace returns as invading hosts withdraw in disarray: Bisutek'in & Wehtle defend their ancestral soil, concluding the War of the Wehtle Crown (5 years).
Ji'a of Bisutek'in carries the faith to the unbelievers in the War of the Wehtle Crown.
Sobige of Wehtle wins the glory sought in the War of the Wehtle Crown.

ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Dictated at swordpoint by Bisutek'in, the old institutions of Cybernetic Union of Wehtle are dismantled! The defeated realm is reorganized into the Trade Federation of Wehtle under a new constitutional treaty.
Ota of Wotenugo takes up the cause of knowledge.
The reign of Fuda II the Lame Lono in Wotenugo concludes with their death (battle wounds). Ota takes up the royal mantle, vowing to defend the realm.
Yne II of Ykunypur takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
The reign of Yne the Peacemaker Yvov in Ykunypur concludes with their death (fever). Yne takes up the royal mantle, vowing to defend the realm.
Opa III of Bopiteto takes up the cause of the safety of the realm.
The death of Fuli Yani (old age) leaves Bopiteto without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Noda seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.
Sisha of Disita takes up the cause of wealth.
Dynastic extinction strikes Disita: Shiqidi dies heirless (old age). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Hizu claims the vacant crown.
Fuba of Yofi takes up the cause of the safety of the realm.
Dynastic extinction strikes Yofi: Ota dies heirless (old age). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Nasono claims the vacant crown.
Sajuta of Sisafar takes up the cause of a lasting legacy.
Dynastic extinction strikes Sisafar: Tafu dies heirless (poison). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Hadu claims the vacant crown.
Ecstatic revelations shake Esobkhot: the prophet Ochuda proclaims divine truths, establishing the foundations of the Ochudaite Heresy.
POPULAR UPRISING: Folk moots and agrarian communes in Ride seize local granaries and cast off the yoke of Sohohmih! The people inaugurate the Free Union of Ride under the stewardship of Leta.
Leta is acclaimed ruler of Free Union of Ride.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Grand Duchy of Sohohmih dispatches punitive legions to subdue Free Union of Ride. The bitter War of Sohohmih is underway.
The civic bell of Rolapa tolls as magistrates and clan heads inaugurate the Tribe of Rolapa, establishing its seat of power.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Covert saboteurs from Qasr Dishabu detonate powder stores in Wehtle, gutting frontline regiments!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Qasr Dishabu are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Wehtle!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Dustetlama embarks upon the Rescue of the Stranded River Barges at Nehtohyihni! Dustetlama learns that a trading fleet has run aground on a falling river bend near Nehtohyihni.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Pegidu pave the Bote-Lidupalida Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Bote and Lidupalida (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Debre Biwiso pave the Debre Biwiso-Muhobu Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Debre Biwiso and Muhobu (+trade, +stability).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Nyxal the Void Dreamer projects psychic void-whispers into the foes of Hurkota! Invaders flee in weeping delirium, haunted by visions of tentacled cosmic voids (+18% army power, -7 stability).
ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Shubbog the Brood Mother spawns thousands of chittering dark young in the sacred groves of Kunokibo, swarming forward under black skies (+20% army power, -6 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Tzannik the Architect of Fate mutates the weave of fate in Tadunge! Arcane mutations grant uncanny clairvoyance and secret gold, at the cost of civil panic (+30 gold, -6 stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Undina of the Silver Basin purifies the sacred rivers of Mepoh! Abundant fish and unhindered river trade enrich the townships (+30 gold, +12 stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Zephyros the Sky-Sovereign hurls deafening thunderbolts across the frontiers of Debre Biwiso, scattering hostile vanguards with righteous gales (+15% army power).
PATRON MIRACLE: Solarius the Dawn-Bringer bestows a radiant dawn upon Ride! Granaries overflow with miraculous golden grain, soothing civil unrest (+18 stability, +20 gold).
The austere procession of the Coven of the Crimson Chalice draws thousands into the public squares of Bopiteto. Their fiery lamentations stir religious fervor and undermine traditional authority.
A righteous knight-errant, Tahu, rides the threatened marches around Bapita! The wandering champion repels bandit hordes and shields vulnerable farming settlements.
The renowned arena champion Opa shatters fighting-pit chains in Yofi! Leading fellow captives in a daring escape, the hero becomes a celebrated defender of the oppressed.
Unrest of the year: sectarian clashes in Tlihiwo (Dugotugondar).

The Great Kediwi War is known as the Reclamation among the Huwu, and as the Usurpation among the Hatadazata.
The Border War of Nasuka is known as the Unification among the Totafo, and as the Subjugation among the Bopodokanale.
Over the centuries Tensusdur has worn down on the tongue into Chensusdur; the older name survives only in the chronicles.
Over the centuries Disita has worn down on the tongue into Disit; the older name survives only in the chronicles.

Midwinter Feast: The longest night in Hobewu is spent by firelight in Hobewu, with stories and gifts.
A catastrophic blow to Al-yashu: legions of Ejney overrun the citadel of Al-yashu, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Night of Shadow Plays: Scholars and singers of Pengu compete in Negibudopada; the best verse is carried through the streets.
Wamonui overruns the defensive holdfasts of Okhidobalik, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Uchünibiqob.
The final citadels fall, and the crown of Free City of Al-yashu is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Lima Daji flees into bitter exile as the realm fades into legend.
A victor's peace is forged: after less than a year of campaign in the Al-yashu Campaign, Ejney prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Yam Feast: Granaries of Lewebaland are opened at Ile-dobe; the whole town eats until dusk.
Rice Blessing: Granaries of Rarpeng are opened at Rarpeng; the whole town eats until dusk.
Festival of the Ancestors: Families in Konedaland set out lamps and food for their dead at Puwilikuta.
With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Trade Federation of Pihtle marches against Principality of Hobewu. The War of the Pihtle Crown begins.

Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the Ejek'in Succession War after 4 years. With frontiers redrawn, Sohohmih & Gezdotmeg & Yupidesh & Nugwem & Lewebaland & Hibisa dictate terms to the vanquished.
Humbled, Republic of Ejek'in bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Sohohmih, paying yearly tribute.
Mesdiq of Gezdotmeg wins the glory sought in the Ejek'in Succession War.
Tunga of Durasorotiwo takes up the cause of knowledge.
A perilous interregnum grips Durasorotiwo following the heirless death of Tokota (a wasting sickness). Retainers of House Siguhatu storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Notshuq of Gezdotmeg takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
In the royal halls of Gezdotmeg, Mesdiq the Hammer Gushwuw breathes their last, succumbing to battle wounds. Notshuq ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.

A catastrophic blow to Hobewu: legions of Pihtle overrun the citadel of Hobewu, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.

Festival of Colours: People of Datikot wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Datikot.

The walls of Ütomokent crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Wamonui breach the defenses of Uchünibiqob's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.

Gewuwe of Ngethani takes up the cause of the safety of the realm.

A wandering mystic named Ochokha appears before the gates of Isacham, gathering disciples with impassioned sermons and igniting the fervent Ochokhaite Heresy.
Insurrection flares in Wohpan! Declaring their liberties inviolable, the populace casts off the yoke of Hurkota and rallies beneath the banner of Chokihse, establishing the Grand Duchy of Wohpan.
Chokihse is acclaimed ruler of Grand Duchy of Wohpan.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Free Trading Cities of Hurkota marches swiftly upon Grand Duchy of Wohpan. The drums of the Conquest of Wohpan echo across the provinces.

POPULAR UPRISING: Folk moots and agrarian communes in Putayu seize local granaries and cast off the yoke of Sohohmih! The people inaugurate the Popular Commonwealth of Dogweh under the stewardship of Mirhonga.
Mirhonga is acclaimed ruler of Popular Commonwealth of Dogweh.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Empire of Sohohmih marches swiftly upon Popular Commonwealth of Dogweh. The drums of the Conquest of Dogweh echo across the provinces.

MERCANTILE SECESSION: Wealthy patricians and merchant cartels in Shapaliga rebel against royal tariffs! Declaring commercial independence from Tilihavarta, Bilata establishes the Commercial Union of Dicuvarta.
Bilata is acclaimed ruler of Commercial Union of Dicuvarta.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Free Union of Tilihavarta dispatches punitive legions to subdue Commercial Union of Dicuvarta. The bitter Invasion of Dicuvarta is underway.

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Crowds fill the avenues of Sohohmih as a mass uprising topples the throne of Empire of Sohohmih! The ancient autocracy is abolished, and Sobige proclaims the sovereign Workers' Federation of Sohohmih!

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Rising against tyranny and privilege, the populace of Ngethani storms the seat of government! With the former regime swept aside, Nenuta proclaims the foundation of the United Provinces of Ngethani!

COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by The revolutionary council strike at midnight in Yupidesh! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Trade Federation of Yupidesh!

POPULAR REVOLUTION: Rising against tyranny and privilege, the populace of Tlimoltlan storms the seat of government! With the former regime swept aside, Hilomihi proclaims the foundation of the United Provinces of Tlimoltlan!

STATE ATHEISM PROCLAIMED: The revolutionary leadership in Tlimoltlan enacts Radical Secularization! State religion is abolished, temple estates and monastery vaults are confiscated for the people (+65 gold), and ancient dogma is suppressed.

COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Yizyth strike in the dead of night, slaying Basu in the court of Unik!

The sun sets upon Iron Dominion of Shapaliga. Bereft of armies and abandoned by vassals, the realm collapses into history; Nitusha Pihi escapes into the wilderness.
The Invasion of Shapaliga reaches its conclusion after 2 years of bloodshed: Tilihavarta triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
The sun sets upon Free Commonwealth of Wewange. Bereft of armies and abandoned by vassals, the realm collapses into history; Naluheta Mopowupe escapes into the wilderness.
A victor's peace is forged: after 1 year of campaign in the Border War of Wewange, Wamonui prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Feast of Breaking the Fast: Bonfires on the hills of Sirizima greet the high sun above Dar Kubi.
First Fruit Offerings: Granaries of Wavemika are opened at Wavemika; the whole town eats until dusk.
Night of Nine Songs: Granaries of Yupidesh are opened at Sododagarh; the whole town eats until dusk.
Festival of the Ancestors: Families in Fimokuda set out lamps and food for their dead at Fimokuda.
After a bitter siege, the ramparts of Sisafar give way! Vanguard forces of Qasr Dibu storm the royal seat of Sisafar, casting down imperial banners and plundering the state vaults.
With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Free Trading Cities of Hurkota marches against People's Republic of Mono. The Hurkota–Mono War begins.
Laso of Fimokuda takes up the cause of the safety of the realm.
The reign of Mibela Iron-Hand Nakebe in Fimokuda concludes with their death (poison). Laso takes up the royal mantle, vowing to defend the realm.
Fupo of Bopiteto takes up the cause of a lasting legacy.
In Bopiteto, Fuba the Watchful Nogo departs this life, succumbing to a fall from a horse. The child Fupo (age 12) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
Iqöra II of Unik takes up the cause of glory.
The bells of Unik toll for the passing of Iqöra the Frail Amit (fever). The youth Iqöra ascends the throne under a regency council.
Mema of Wemoho comes to the throne bent on knowledge.
A perilous interregnum grips Wemoho following the heirless death of Vuwelufa (old age). Retainers of House Notu storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Prosperity shines upon Gezdotmeg: master architects and poets flock to Gezdotmeg as coffers overflow and harvests reach record yields.
Nenmob (Archmage) unravels a supernatural anomaly in the mountains in Sis'aynal.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Bomọba! Futo seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Kingdom of Bomọba!
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Paba strike at midnight in Witajaw! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the High Realm of Witajaw!
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Gezdotmeg! Tidodu seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Divine Realm of Gezdotmeg!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Counterfeit letters planted by Hubu rupture trust between Sohohmih and their ally Negapura!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Wehtle are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Hurkota!
QUEST COMPLETED: Search for the Lost Relic in Lewumome! Sohmihi unlocks the sealed adamantine vault, unearthing the sacred relic Shadowed Shard of Quzi to global acclaim!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Qasr Dibu pave the Qasr Dibu-Wemoho Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Qasr Dibu and Wemoho (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Wemoho pave the Vepapenui-Wavemika Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Vepapenui and Wavemika (+trade, +stability).

DIVINE PROXY WAR: The war between Hurkota and Mono escalates into a celestial proxy duel! Nyxal the Void Dreamer rallies the hosts of Hurkota, while Zephyros the Sky-Sovereign unleashes sacred omens to shield Mono.
RUINOUS GIFT: Tzannik the Architect of Fate mutates the weave of fate in Tadunge! Arcane mutations grant uncanny clairvoyance and secret gold, at the cost of civil panic (+30 gold, -6 stability).

monsters.name: The Deep Lake Wyrm
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: Tusk-Lord of the Briars
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: The Storm Roc of the Badlands
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: Ignis the Red Calamity
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: White Tiger of the Ridge
monsters.lore: A colossal pale tiger of snow-clad ridges, silent as autumn wind, that warbands speak of only in whispers.

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Ponaturi Night-Raiders
monsters.lore: Hostile sea goblins of the old hero tales who sleep beneath the waves by day and come ashore at night; sunlight destroys them.

monsters.name: The Ahuizotl of the Lake
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

monsters.name: The Steppe Cyclops
monsters.lore: A one-eyed giant of the steppe epics, slain only by a hero clever enough to blind him.

monsters.name: The White Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.name: the Shard Colossus
monsters.lore: Wild magic given a body, it wanders the land the surge burned.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

SEA EMBARGO: Wote seals the deep channels, and no hull leaves the port of Chihtitlan for Tlewtek.
The sun sets upon Grand Duchy of Riabad. Bereft of armies and abandoned by vassals, the realm collapses into history; Miudoashai Giashailia escapes into the wilderness.
Envoys convene upon neutral ground to ratify a solemn treaty, concluding the War of the Tlatkit Crown after 3 years. With frontiers redrawn, Tlatkit dictate terms to the vanquished.
A catastrophic blow to Yekiwosipofe: legions of Jitun overrun the citadel of Nifeguse, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
A catastrophic blow to Myingemfi: legions of Nkawa overrun the citadel of Nkawa, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Mage Republic of Qighxyth launches a determined invasion into Workers' Federation of Lakane, igniting the Qighxyth Succession War.
Gozzova of Finsop turns from the old cause toward wealth.
Solemn rites echo through Finsop following the death of Zipsharp II the Conqueror Keyzhpokh (a fall from a horse). Gozzova is crowned sovereign before the assembled court.
Hohameko II of Kuma comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
In Kuma, Hohameko the Grim Vetela departs this life, succumbing to a wasting sickness. The child Hohameko (age 8) is crowned beneath a wary council of regents.
Gozfilk of Satshahr comes to the throne bent on the fortunes of the dynasty.
Dynastic extinction strikes Satshahr: Shatripa dies heirless (a wasting sickness). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Kartmim claims the vacant crown.

POPULAR UPRISING: Folk moots and agrarian communes in Nkawa seize local granaries and cast off the yoke of Nkawa! The people inaugurate the Workers' Federation of Nkawa under the stewardship of Myimga.
Myimga is acclaimed ruler of Workers' Federation of Nkawa.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Free Commonwealth of Nkawa dispatches punitive legions to subdue Workers' Federation of Nkawa. The bitter Border War of Nkawa is underway.

Insurrection flares in Nyombe! Declaring their liberties inviolable, the populace casts off the yoke of Myinmunminme and rallies beneath the banner of Chahteh, establishing the Stratocracy of Chantat.
Chahteh is acclaimed ruler of Stratocracy of Chantat.

Outraged by treason, the crown of Workers' Federation of Myinmunminme mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Stratocracy of Chantat. The Conquest of Chantat begins in fire and iron.
The curse of drought descends upon Axtut: fields yield only dust, and famine spreads across the provinces.
Hyrzax opens the royal granaries of Axtut; bread is carted to every village and the people bless the crown.
Wulbeka (Master Artisan) unveils a breathtaking marble colossus in the central plaza in Jejwiybu'.
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Nagrâch strike at midnight in Ogdjuj! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Ogdjuj!
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Kompakhey storm the government palace in Myinmunminme! The faction seizes control, establishing the Patriarchate of Myinmunminme.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Wovowe stir mutiny among garrison troops in Axtut!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Wonge are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Chantat!
QUEST COMPLETED: Rescue of the Royal Heir in Weythani! Utcha successfully frees the captive, escorting them to safety and earning 100 Gold in grateful tribute!

QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Pemtak embarks upon the The Flower-War Duel at Ngofukume! Pemtak receives a formal challenge to a flower-war duel with the champion of Ngofukume, fought for honour, not for conquest.

NATURE BLESSING: Undina of the Silver Basin purifies the sacred rivers of Nkawa! Abundant fish and unhindered river trade enrich the townships (+30 gold, +12 stability).

Dynastic extinction strikes Puwwib: Koysub dies heirless (poison). Amid whispers of poison and sword-drawn councils, House Puwyom claims the vacant crown.
Upon the fertile crossroads of Radpura, allied elders and chieftains swear a founding compact, raising the banners of the sovereign Chiefdom of Radpura.
Prosperity shines upon Diqoqia: master architects and poets flock to Capu as coffers overflow and harvests reach record yields.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Rongame are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Xytyth!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Jaltum embarks upon the Recovery of the Crown Jewels in Nevo! Jaltum deciphers faded parchment maps and astrological charts pointing toward the vaults of Nevo.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Nkinza pave the Nkinza-Nyombe Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Nkinza and Nyombe (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Toudesh pave the Mwenyu-Toigarh Maritime Lane, establishing a direct route between Mwenyu and Toigarh (+trade, +stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Omnipotis the Sovereign Architect manifests the Sovereign Mandate in Wamọba! Incorruptible celestial magistrates codify sacred law, crushing unrest (+20 stability, +15 gold).
Chanting somber litanies, the The Veiled Covenant parades through Kiqyeh, rebuking high prelates and demanding immediate spiritual penance from the lords of Kiqyeh.
The fiery prophet Keq'yox ascends the temple steps in Xohrextox, summoning the faithful to sacred struggle! Zealous disciples rally to the holy banner, vowing to defend their sacred honor.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Cosele (Ogdjuj).

monsters.name: The Great Calydonian Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: The Deep Lake Wyrm
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: Behemoth the Earth-Shaker
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Brimstone the Dragon-King
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: The Dune-Shadow Roc
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: The Great Sun Lion
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Ahuizotl of the Lake
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

monsters.name: The River-Blocker
monsters.lore: A huge river creature of the deep forest that blocks the flow of rivers with its body.

monsters.name: The Timingila of the Deep
monsters.lore: A sea monster of the old epics so vast it swallows whales whole, and is itself swallowed by something larger still.

monsters.name: The Each-uisge of the Loch
monsters.lore: A water horse that lets riders mount, then plunges into the loch with them stuck fast.

monsters.name: the Spellscar Wyrm
monsters.lore: A serpent of raw magic born where a leyline tore open.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Feathered Serpent of the Chenhechyil

monsters.name: the Walking Rift
monsters.lore: Wild magic given a body, it wanders the land the surge burned.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Pontifex of Tifapapusu

monsters.name: the Pale Surge
monsters.lore: A hungry ghost of spent magic that drains the living.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Navigator Gods of the Hiwemanu

monsters.name: the Burning Line
monsters.lore: A serpent of raw magic born where a leyline tore open.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Reformed Covenant of Polkitwiy

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

Bilad Lila overruns the defensive holdfasts of Yelhoykand, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Basgird.
Canoe Launching: People of Rukola wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Lofuwahu.
Feast of the Return Voyage: Boats of Lutive are blessed and raced off Lutive; sailors are toasted ashore.
Nutebeland overruns the defensive holdfasts of Kelọ, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Ngefonu.
A catastrophic blow to Ngefonu: legions of Nutebeland overrun the citadel of Ngengoloho, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Ullihza of Ektyqlyth takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
In the royal halls of Ektyqlyth, Uhlyrqelk II the Conqueror Ukhyrl breathes their last, succumbing to old age. Ullihza ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.
Sarpashi of Civney takes up the cause of wealth.
The death of Parkut Soscalvop (fever) leaves Civney without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Lodshid seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.
Sashi of Kata takes up the cause of the fortunes of the dynasty.
A perilous interregnum grips Kata following the heirless death of Linu (a hunting accident). Retainers of House Fubu storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
Defying the crown of Loluchabali, the garrison and civic guilds of Kafstan mutiny! The sovereign Principality of Baszamin is declared with Medguva at its helm.
Medguva is acclaimed ruler of Principality of Baszamin.

Outraged by treason, the crown of People's Republic of Loluchabali mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Principality of Baszamin. The Invasion of Baszamin begins in fire and iron.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Declaring citizen liberty inviolable, the populace of Ytzugg casts out imperial governors! Renouncing allegiance to Lafolọba, Atzulhyrxa proclaims the sovereign Confederation of Ytzugg.
Atzulhyrxa is acclaimed ruler of Confederation of Ytzugg.
Outraged by treason, the crown of Principality of Lafolọba mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in Confederation of Ytzugg. The Great Lafolọba War begins in fire and iron.
Blight strikes the grain harvests of Kata; hunger stalks village and city alike as bread prices soar.
The lords of Kata hoard grain and sell it dear; Sashi grows richer as the villages empty.
Dopu (Master Artisan) composes an immortal ballad that brings tears to commoners and kings alike in Fachoby.
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Eqharz strike at midnight in Ytzirl! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Empire of Ytzirl!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Likongo sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Hihchech.

OVER-FARMING DUST BOWL: Decades of intensive cultivation and overgrazing exhaust the arid topsoil around the hinterlands of Muvomyby. Violent dust storms sweep the plains, suffocating crops and forcing herders into exile.

ARCANE MELTDOWN: Unstable alchemy and runaway leyline containment experiments detonate violently near Arcane Proving Grounds of Cell 1059! Magical shockwaves scorch the earth into irradiated ash, collapsing towers and displacing hundreds.
QUEST COMPLETED: Recovery of the Chant Staff of Lofuwahu! Lorila brings the staff to the elders, who chant it whole again and reward the sacred relic Ancient Orb of Kone!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Ghexxaxa embarks upon the Search for the Lost Relic in Irkatt! Ghexxaxa deciphers faded parchment maps and astrological charts pointing toward the vaults of Irkatt.

EXPEDITION TRIUMPH: Mebrir and the hosts of Gashdar defeat Brimstone the Dragon-King, banishing the immortal titan into deep slumber in Wilds beyond Rope! Spoils: Pyre-Forged Cleaver (Ancient Dragon Blood & Pyre Scales), boosting stability (+20) and treasury (+150 gold).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Pove pave the Basofe-Qiraqifuna Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Basofe and Qiraqifuna (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Ytzugg pave the Ytzugg-Ile-rakonu Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Ytzugg and Ile-rakonu (+trade, +stability).

Sarpashi of Civney fills the treasury, the wealth long sought.
Itlith of Uttakt lets go of the aim for the spread of the faith.
Zak'uhyu of Hurkota Beyond keeps the realm whole through 20 hard years.
Arluth conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Iron Plains) using magic (score 30 vs DC 8). Defeated Sylas. Promoted to F-Rank!

Something sings beneath Tundun on the night without stars; the people of Xakhagugg hum along without knowing why.
Bikowi lifts its measures against the Witatitu. Few believe it will last, but the burnings stop.
Under the hand of Ghutyth, Tyy'yzyeh gives up communes for free guilds.
Something vast stirs in the lightless depths beneath Akkyth; the deep wardens double their watch.

Kuwia squeezes the shaft-tolls of Cungfidu; the miners of Lafolọba mutter beneath the stone.
Flames engulf the towers of Kafstan! Soldiers of Loluchabali force the inner courtyards of Baszamin's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
Flames engulf the towers of Takengolo! Soldiers of Nutebeland force the inner courtyards of Ngefonu's capital; the royal garrison breaks, and the seat of power falls.
WONDER DESTROYED: The Eternal Megacity (🏙️) has fallen! Nutebeland brought ruin upon the legendary site (sacked and razed during siege conquest). Its ancient spires now lie in shattered ruins.
Gashdar overruns the defensive holdfasts of Mikchin, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Bytsahugorod.
Canoe Launching: People of Pove wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Basofe.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Democratic Union of Ngefonu ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Ngufuma Lavefa flees the ashes of their former dominion.
Yam Feast: Granaries of Nepukofe are opened at Nepukofe; the whole town eats until dusk.
The Ngefonu Campaign reaches its conclusion after 4 years of bloodshed: Nutebeland & Bilad Lila & Rosọba triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Night of Opening Eyes: Families in Irkatt set out lamps and food for their dead at Irkatt.
A catastrophic blow to Basgird: legions of Bilad Lila overrun the citadel of Basgird, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Envoys from Nutebeland and Sebido exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Ambition stirs in the courts of Democratic Union of Hinstan, which openly claims dominion over Principality of Uttakt. The realm braces as the Invasion of Uttakt erupts.

Wang of Hunguo turns from the old cause toward the safety of the realm.
The death of Bina Dinghung (battle wounds) leaves Hunguo without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Nanqon seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.
Yxkezluhla of Ytzugg takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
The death of Uhlyrqelk Ittell (old age) leaves Ytzugg without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Ixraxluxx seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.
Insurrection flares in Kafstan! Declaring their liberties inviolable, the populace casts off the yoke of Loluchabali and rallies beneath the banner of Guvnofa, establishing the Empire of Bashahr.
Guvnofa is acclaimed ruler of Empire of Bashahr.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, People's Republic of Loluchabali marches swiftly upon Empire of Bashahr. The drums of the Bashahr Campaign echo across the provinces.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal tithes and noble exploitation, the laborers of Cungfidu rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Lafolọba, they establish the Commune of Qenguo with Sungzunga leading the commune.
Sungzunga is acclaimed ruler of Commune of Qenguo.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Principality of Lafolọba marches swiftly upon Commune of Qenguo. The drums of the Lafolọba Succession War echo across the provinces.
The civic bell of Konpen tolls as magistrates and clan heads inaugurate the Chiefdom of Konpen, establishing its seat of power.
Tunpung (Philosopher) calculates the true circumference of the world from tower shadows in Bonwan.
Koga (Master Artisan) composes an immortal ballad that brings tears to commoners and kings alike in Minahangu.

QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Osa embarks upon the Return of the Stolen Mask of Dandunan! Osa hears that a carved masquerade mask was stolen from a compound at Dandunan.

A courageous local hunter, Bengsona, fells a ferocious marauding terror near Tundun! Grateful townsfolk hoist the slayer on their shoulders and crown their new folk protector.
Walking unharmed across contested frontiers, Noke arrives at Sopeshice with tidings of sacred peace. War cohorts drop their spears in reverence, touched by the prophet's words.
Clad in simple sackcloth, the reformer Raqufa enters the gates of Kata, fearlessly rebuking the decadence of imperial courts and summoning magistrates to humility.
A righteous knight-errant, Lenking, rides the threatened marches around Konpen! The wandering champion repels bandit hordes and shields vulnerable farming settlements.

Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Military Junta of Lafolọba launches a determined invasion into Chiefdom of Mokehavituke, igniting the Great Lafolọba War.
Denouncing ancient covenants, the heralds of Principality of Baszamin proclaim war upon Merchant League of Gåthø. Trumpets sound across the frontier as the War of the Baszamin Crown begins.
A victor's peace is forged: after 2 years of campaign in the War of Kuwia, Kuwia & Sebido prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Humbled, Confederation of Ytzugg bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Kuwia, paying yearly tribute.
Neither camp can break the front: envoys sign a mutual cessation of hostilities, ending the War of the Baszamin Crown (less than a year) in an uneasy truce.
Kansepkhud of Fengaphoy takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
The bells of Fengaphoy toll for the passing of Dilseslea the Watchful Namvatzuy (old age). The youth Kansepkhud ascends the throne under a regency council.
Vewirota of Lukangomingo turns from the old cause toward the safety of the realm.
Mourning envelops Lukangomingo: Hepa Wave-Rider Mehatutotiwa dies of poison. The royal scepter passes to Vewirota, an underage youth of 7 years, under the stewardship of high chancellors.

THE GREAT REFORMATION: In Makọ, Pimo nails ninety-five theses condemning clerical indulgence! Proclaiming the Reformed Covenant of Makọ, reformers split from ancient dogma. Riots break out as iconoclasts smash old idols.
Galled by heavy tithes and distant decrees, the citizens of Kime cast out their bailiffs! Renouncing all allegiance to Hangika, Wefu proclaims the sovereign Grand Marshalate of Kime.
Wefu is acclaimed ruler of Grand Marshalate of Kime.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Commercial Union of Hangika dispatches punitive legions to subdue Grand Marshalate of Kime. The bitter Great Hangika War is underway.
Sickness walks by day and night in the frontier: a deadly plague takes hold, emptying bustling thoroughfares.
Sickness walks by day and night in Rotshagmem: a deadly plague takes hold, emptying bustling thoroughfares.
Raverofu (Master Artisan) stages a grand theatrical masterpiece celebrating freedom in Povonui.
Huqlilkyqa (Grand Champion) defeats a formidable foreign knight in single combat before the royal court in Latugg.
Kopehmewa (Archmage) weaves a protective arcane ward over the city walls in Rope.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Rotirorevo! Niranumu seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Grand Duchy of Rotirorevo!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Shapohiga are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Baszamin!
QUEST COMPLETED: Mending the Talking Drum Tower of Ile-rakonu! Piso hears the drum speak across the city again, and elders bestow Immortal Renown and a steadier realm!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Mokọba pave the Kegoloni-Mokehavituke Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Kegoloni and Mokehavituke (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Lafolọba pave the Sihpan-Tasseshuacan Maritime Lane, establishing a direct route between Sihpan and Tasseshuacan (+trade, +stability).

DIVINE PROXY WAR: The war between Khetshahr and Gåthø escalates into a celestial proxy duel! Thalor the All-Seeing Mind rallies the hosts of Khetshahr, while Luxuria the Gilded Prince unleashes sacred omens to shield Gåthø.
NATURE BLESSING: Ignis the Hearth Caldera stokes the caldera hearths of Lihseshuacan! Master smiths forge shimmering obsidian weaponry bathed in magma (+16% army power, +15 gold).
CHAOS WRATH: Pestilax the Rot-Father vents noxious rot through Cardac! Horrific gangrene strikes garrisons and spoils granaries (-12% army power, -16 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Luxuria the Gilded Prince intoxicates the high courts of Gåthø with exquisite hedonism! Opulence surges alongside reckless decadence (+40 gold, -10 stability).

A sinister esoteric cabal, the Order of the Black Eclipse, is uncovered in the deep catacombs beneath Ytzirl. Initiates conduct forbidden midnight rites to nameless star-gods, inciting widespread dread.
Defying cruel overseers, Ngulufonga leads an uprising in the arena quarter of Lutive. Freed combatants rally behind the champion's banner, sworn to protect the weak.
Unrest of the year: bread riots in Yinitego (Nutebeland); sectarian clashes in Eghxitt (Sengwing).

Bindeng of Qinling secures the line, with Lunfonga grown to take the crown.
Xoxre'rih conquered Floor 1 (Floor of the Iron Plains) using assault (score 27 vs DC 8). Defeated Sylas. Promoted to F-Rank!
Bihaqi survived descent to Layer 1 (Edge of the Abyss), enduring 11 strain damage: Light dizziness and loss of balance upon ascent. Whistle tier: red. Salvaged ancient relic: Sun Stone Shard!
Something sings beneath Izzitt on the night without stars; the people of Ektyqlyth hum along without knowing why.
The geometry of Haghxyloth is rebuilt at angles that hurt to look at; Hurkota Beyond calls it progress.
The Verdant Consort of Tangbun finds patrons in Hihchech.
Gåthø crushes a society of abolitionists; its leaders hang and the bondsfolk are bound tighter.
The overdrawn leyline at the holy seat of Sun Cult of Posihkah surges: wild magic scours the land of Nehyi and the mages are struck down.
Something vast stirs in the lightless depths beneath Yrryth; the deep wardens double their watch.
The tiny Free City of Qiriqa seeks shelter and is peacefully absorbed into Nehyi.
The War of Kuwia is known as the Reclamation among the Rinibi, and as the Usurpation among the Ilxihretz.
A catastrophic blow to Gåthø: legions of Khetshahr overrun the citadel of Kafstan, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Garrison at Kerypi repels a cross-planet invasion pouring through the Singing Tear!

monsters.name: The Primeval Behemoth
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Draugr of the Howe
monsters.lore: An undead warrior who guards the treasure of its burial mound, growing heavier than an ox.

monsters.name: The Ponaturi of the Reef
monsters.lore: Hostile sea goblins of the old hero tales who sleep beneath the waves by day and come ashore at night; sunlight destroys them.

monsters.name: Timingila the Whale-Swallower
monsters.lore: A sea monster of the old epics so vast it swallows whales whole, and is itself swallowed by something larger still.

monsters.name: Hand-Tailed Ahuizotl
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

monsters.name: the Burning Line
monsters.lore: A serpent of raw magic born where a leyline tore open.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Flame of Dofshesh

monsters.name: the Drinker of Spells
monsters.lore: A hungry ghost of spent magic that drains the living.
monsters.lair: the scar at the holy seat of Dharma of Nudpaygan

monsters.name: the Shard Colossus
monsters.lore: Wild magic given a body, it wanders the land the surge burned.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
